title: Leading patterns of sea-level variability and what they mean
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly sea surface height, temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), find the leading patterns of sea surface height variability with an empirical decomposition, determine how much variance each holds and how well they are separated from one another, and test whether each corresponds to an identifiable physical process. Show how the patterns change with the domain, with the removal of the seasonal cycle and the trend, and with the years used, and state which of them you would trust as an index of the regional circulation.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
